name: viewforge-3d-toolkit
description: Quality-gated local geometry generation, multi-view 3D construction, controlled Blender modeling and rendering, biological skeleton animation, no-skin rigid binding, mesh refinement, and same-geometry appearance skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build, render, animate, rig, and refine traceable 3D models.
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled local geometry runtime for procedural and multi-view modeling, controlled declarative Blender jobs, and fixed-view rendering for general objects; create and animate bone-only biological armatures, rigid-bind segmented models without skin weights, refine bounded regions, validate topology and provenance, and apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:viewforge-3d-router to choose the safe workflow for this 3D task.
Call viewforge_status first. Prefer bundled tools; use build_declarative_blender_model for controlled Blender jobs.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:render-model-preview to render a registered Blend or GLB and return its contact sheet to the conversation.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:build-biological-skeleton for a bone-only human or animal Armature without weights.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:animate-biological-skeleton to animate and rigid-bind segmented parts without skin weights.
